notes.title: Olympia Rising Update V1.1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We fixed up a couple of bugs that were causing some game crashes and tuned up a couple of other items as well. We will continue to fix issues that are brought to our attention.  

Thanks for all of the continued support and feedback since release!

- Rob G.
